# IPS Dated Sites — exact pins, deliberately.
#
# The generated SVGs carry the matplotlib version in their metadata, and
# the clip-path identifiers are deterministic only WITHIN one version. A
# range such as "matplotlib>=3.8" therefore produces different files
# locally and in CI, and the drift check in .github/workflows/build.yml
# fires although nobody changed anything. That is exactly what happened on
# the first CI run: 3.9.2 locally, 3.10.9 on the runner.
#
# Whoever raises a version runs `python py/main.py` once afterwards and
# commits the regenerated files with it.

rdflib==7.1.1         # 7.5 drops the gYear warnings, see py/ips_compat.py
pandas==2.2.3
matplotlib==3.9.2     # recorded in the SVG metadata, see above
pillow==10.4.0        # needed by matplotlib for the JPG output
numpy==1.26.4         # transitive, pinned anyway for full reproducibility

# Query page: queries.yaml -> docs/sparql.html (py/build_sparql.py)
pyyaml==6.0.3
jinja2==3.1.6
